items.name: 5.56 mm Semi-Automatic Rifle
items.description: A shoulder-fired detachable-magazine rifle chambered for 5.56 mm ammunition and configured for semiautomatic fire.

items.name: 9×19 mm Carbine
items.description: A shoulder-fired magazine-fed carbine chambered for 9×19 mm ammunition, offering greater stability and useful range than a sidearm.

items.name: 9mm Luger
items.description: A compact magazine-fed sidearm chambered for 9×19 mm ammunition and designed for semiautomatic fire.

items.name: Blunderbuss
items.description: A blunderbuss designed for ranged combat.

items.name: Cannon
items.description: Heavy siege or pirate weapon.

items.name: Composite Bow
items.description: Advanced design with laminated limbs.

items.name: Derringer Pistol
items.description: A derringer pistol designed for ranged combat.

items.name: Flare Gun
items.description: A flare gun designed for ranged combat.

items.name: Flintlock Pistol
items.description: Black powder pistol.

items.name: Hand Cannon
items.description: Crude, oversized single-shot gun.

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.description: Compact crossbow, sometimes hidden in a sleeve.

items.name: Hand Mortar
items.description: Primitive handheld cannon.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow
items.description: A large crossbow designed for greater projectile force at the cost of slower loading.

items.name: Heavy Machine Gun
items.description: A heavy machine gun designed for ranged combat.

items.name: Hunting Rifle
items.description: A hunting rifle designed for ranged combat.

items.name: Lever-Action Rifle
items.description: A lever-action rifle designed for ranged combat.

items.name: Light Crossbow
items.description: A crossbow designed for comparatively lighter handling than heavier battlefield crossbows.

items.name: Longbow
items.description: A tall bow designed to deliver arrows with substantial power and range.

items.name: Machine Gun
items.description: High rate of fire, eats ammo.

items.name: Musket
items.description: A muzzle-loading long firearm using black-powder or comparable early firearm technology.

items.name: Repeating Crossbow
items.description: A crossbow incorporating a mechanism that allows multiple shots before a conventional reload cycle.

items.name: Repeating Musket
items.description: Steampunk multi-shot musket.

items.name: .357 Revolver
items.description: A handgun using a rotating cylinder to hold and index ammunition.

items.name: Shortbow
items.description: A relatively compact bow designed to propel arrows at range.

items.name: Shotgun
items.description: A shoulder-fired firearm designed to fire shotgun ammunition.

items.name: Sniper Rifle
items.description: A rifle configured and designed for precision fire at extended range.

items.name: Steam Rifle
items.description: Steampunk-era pressurized rifle.

items.name: Submachine Gun
items.description: A compact automatic firearm designed to fire handgun-class ammunition.

items.name: 5.56×45 mm Cartridge
items.description: A lightweight rifle cartridge used by compatible 5.56 mm rifles and carbines.

items.name: 9×19 mm Cartridge
items.description: A complete 9×19 mm firearm cartridge used by compatible pistols, carbines, and other weapons chambered for the same round.

items.name: Arrow
items.description: A simple arrow with a shaft, fletching, and a basic piercing head for use with compatible bows.

items.name: Cannonball
items.description: A heavy solid projectile used by compatible cannons.

items.name: Crossbow Bolt
items.description: A short rigid bolt designed for use with compatible crossbows.

items.name: Flare Cartridge
items.description: A self-contained flare-gun cartridge that launches a pyrotechnic flare for signaling or illumination.

items.name: Musket Ball
items.description: A simple round projectile used by compatible black-powder firearms.

items.name: Shotgun Shell
items.description: A complete shotgun shell used by compatible shotguns.

items.name: Whaling Gun
items.description: Fires harpoons attached to ropes.

items.name: 357 Round
items.description: A complete 357 magnum firearm cartridge used by compatible pistols, carbines, and other weapons chambered for the same round.

items.name: Blunderbuss Shot Charge
items.description: A complete ammunition charge for the catalog Blunderbuss.

items.name: Derringer Cartridge
items.description: A cartridge for the catalog Derringer Pistol; no real-world caliber is implied.

items.name: Hand Cannon Ball Charge
items.description: A complete ball charge for the catalog Hand Cannon.

items.name: Hand Mortar Projectile
items.description: A projectile for the catalog Hand Mortar. Payload and blast behavior remain unconfirmed; this definition does not grant area damage.

items.name: Heavy Machine Gun Cartridge
items.description: A cartridge for the catalog Heavy Machine Gun; no belt or magazine compatibility is implied.

items.name: Hunting Rifle Cartridge
items.description: A cartridge for the catalog Hunting Rifle; no real-world caliber is implied.

items.name: Lever-Action Rifle Cartridge
items.description: A cartridge for the catalog Lever-Action Rifle; no real-world caliber is implied.

items.name: Machine Gun Cartridge
items.description: A cartridge for the catalog Machine Gun; no belt or magazine compatibility is implied.

items.name: Sniper Rifle Cartridge
items.description: A cartridge for the catalog Sniper Rifle; no real-world caliber is implied.

items.name: Steam Rifle Projectile
items.description: A projectile for the catalog pressurized Steam Rifle. Pressure supply and loading mechanism remain unconfirmed.

items.name: Submachine Gun Cartridge
items.description: A handgun-class cartridge for the catalog Submachine Gun; no real-world caliber is implied.

items.name: Whaling Gun Harpoon
items.description: A tethered harpoon projectile for the catalog Whaling Gun. Tether handling requires a G.O.D. ruling and is not automated by this definition.
